mode: inside Claude Code: every operation is one claude -p turn in a scratch git project, Nemp loaded with --plugin-dir
door: claude -p "/nemp:context <question>" --model sonnet --output-format stream-json; the door is everything the model received from its tools during the turn
results: none: the model reads the whole memories.json on every lookup; no cut
model: Claude sonnet through Claude Code: runs every save and every lookup (compresses values, matches in its head)
storage: a JSON file in the project (.nemp/memories.json)
not_default: plugin loaded per call with --plugin-dir, project settings only (--setting-sources project), no MCP servers (--strict-mcp-config), tools limited to Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, --permission-mode acceptEdits, no session persistence, model fixed to sonnet (each call isolated and reproducible)
